cyberpanelPluginConfig.name: Limited phpMyAdmin
cyberpanelPluginConfig.description: Issue dedicated MySQL users with access to a single database for phpMyAdmin. Label grants by FTP or CyberPanel user; disable without deleting. Optional MySQL privilege profiles, strict mode and per-tab preference blocking for cpma users, global and per-grant phpMyAdmin launch links (validity hours and single- or multi-use), tabbed Modify grant UI, and policy saved under CyberCP pluginState. Free plugin.
cyberpanelPluginConfig.author: master3395
